title: The premium AI study tool everyone's using
scenario: A classmate shares a link in your course group chat to a 'premium' AI study tool that's helped everyone with exam prep - you just need to sign in with your university account to get access.

answers.A: Sign in since a classmate already vouched for it.
answers.B: Sign in, and also share the link further in the group chat.
answers.C: Check whether the tool is officially supported before signing in with your university login.

explanation: Signing into a third-party site with your university credentials can hand that site your whole student account, even when the recommendation comes from someone you trust.
proTip: A classmate's endorsement doesn't make your university login safe to hand to a random site.
